text:
Dear Mr Palmer,

you asked whether the car can still be inspected. I'm afraid not as it was: my garage in Olten replaced the smashed rear window on 30 June, two days after the theft, and cleaned all the glass out of the boot and the back seat. The car looks normal again.

On the receipts, I can't help you, and I've really tried. The drone and the camera were bought from private sellers online, and the shop that sold me the binoculars closed down last year. I don't have any receipts and I can't get copies from anyone.

I've attached my policy.

Here's what happened, in case it didn't come across clearly on the phone. On Sunday 28 June 2026 my partner Laura Walsh and I drove to Basel for the day. I parked in a public car park near the zoo around ten and locked the car. The drone in its case, my camera bag and a pair of binoculars were in the boot under a blanket. When we came back at five, the rear side window was smashed and the boot had been emptied. The loss is CHF 7,250.

As far as the cover goes, I should point out that I've had the extra insurance for simple theft away from home since May 2026. It was added to my policy on 8 May, so it was already in place when this happened.

Best regards,
Chris Carter
Rosenweg 76, Olten
